# stronger than

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:strongerThan`](gmeow-strongerThan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/strongerThan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Orders authority levels: the subject level carries more claimed authority than the object level. Transitive ON LEVELS ONLY (the [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) pattern) — norms themselves are ordered by pairwise [`gmeow:overrides`](gmeow-overrides.md) claims, never transitively.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) -> [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:strongerThan`](gmeow-strongerThan.md) from [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) to [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to order two [`gmeow:AuthorityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-AuthorityLevel.md) individuals so that 'at or above an authority grade' is well-defined for solver-side precedence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it between norms (norms are ordered by pairwise [`gmeow:overrides`](gmeow-overrides.md), never by this level order) and avoid relying on it to entail which norm wins — that is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:strongerThan`](gmeow-strongerThan.md) from the stronger level to the weaker; transitivity builds the ladder on the levels only, mirroring the kernel [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) pattern.

- [`gmeow:authorityAbsolute`](../individuals/gmeow-authorityAbsolute.md) [`gmeow:strongerThan`](gmeow-strongerThan.md) [`gmeow:authorityHigh`](../individuals/gmeow-authorityHigh.md).
